clips.title: The story
paras: Cold surf breaks along North Tide's Run, Silverpine Forest's northwestern shore. A half-sunken ship marks the strand, where young tauren druids come to test themselves in the sea.
North Tide's Run follows Silverpine Forest's northwestern edge beside the Great Sea. Cold sand meets pounding surf, and a partly sunken ship rests tilted in the shallows near the beach.

Young tauren druids come to North Tide's Run on pilgrimage along the path of Cenarius. They dive for relics lost to the waves, testing their breath and endurance as they seek the blessing of the aquatic form.
